details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: local privilege escalation via mount option injection
     in mount.cifs
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-104715.patch: in mount.cifs.c, reject
       username and domain values containing ",", "=", CR or LF when they
       come from a credentials file, the USER environment variable or the
       passwd database, and guard against getusername() returning NULL.
     - CVE-2026-104715
